paper_title: MathOdyssey Benchmarking Mathematical Problem-Solving Skills in Large   Language Models Using Odyssey Math Data
caption: There are three answer-types: True-False questions, Multiple-Choice questions and Open-Answer questions.
model_annotation: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of answer types within a dataset of mathematical problems. The chart is divided into three segments, representing True-False, Multiple-Choice, and Open-Answer questions. The slice labeled "True-False" is colored green and occupies approximately 16%, while the "Multiple-Choice" slice, colored orange, accounts for roughly 32.8% of the data. The largest segment, colored blue, represents "Open-Answer" questions and comprises approximately 63% of the total. Percentage labels are present inside each slice. The chart includes a legend identifying the color-coded answer types, and the segments are visually ordered from smallest to largest.
